title: Manim CE
idiom: mathematical diagram in the style of a hand-drawn scientific illustration — think mid-century academic chalkboard diagram or a Haeckel-influenced geometric plate, ink on aged paper, high contrast
hero_prompt: A wide hand-drawn scientific illustration in the style of a mid-century academic chalkboard diagram, ink on aged cream paper: a large unit circle occupies the left half, a phase arrow mid-sweep tracing a sinusoidal wave that unfurls rightward across the frame like a ribbon unspooling from the circle's rim — the wave's peaks and troughs rendered in careful cross-hatching. A second smaller circle sits above with its own arrow at a different angle, its wave interleaving with the first in a gentle beat pattern. LaTeX-style hand-lettered Greek letters (theta, omega) annotate key points but carry NO complete words, numerals, or labels — purely pictorial mathematical annotation as pure graphic mark. Dark ink on warm parchment, high contrast, no color, no CGI rendering, no letters, numerals, words, or labels — purely pictorial.
icon_prompt: Bold high-contrast square emblem: a single unit circle with a thick phase arrow at roughly 2 o'clock, the arrow's tip touching a sine-wave crest that curves away to the right — both shapes rendered as heavy ink strokes on white, pure black and white, geometric clarity. The arrow and wave are the whole composition — no text, no numerals, no labels, no fine linework, no gradients. Survives at 24px.
